verdict.rationale: GitLab documents Personal Access Tokens and SSH keys as programmatic credential mechanisms (gitlab-docs-5, gitlab-docs-6, gitlab-docs-10), which support scoping to specific permissions, and has an MCP server/CLI surface for agents (gitlab-probe-2, gitlab-probe-3), but there is no explicit documentation of an agent-specific least-privilege credential/token type or workflow tailored to AI agents. Missing for 10: dedicated agent-scoped token type or docs explicitly tying token scoping to AI agent use cases, and independent verification of least-privilege enforcement in practice.
